text: The package read the bait AWS credentials file and then attempted to use the harvested key against fake GitHub and npm endpoints, including spawning curl with the token in an Authorization header and probing the cloud metadata address and AWS STS. That pattern of credential theft followed by token replay is what makes this critical, and it behaves like the Shai-Hulud worm incident rather than being confirmed as the same attack. Nothing left the sandbox and no files persisted, but the code clearly intends credential exfiltration. Do not merge this dependency; remove or pin away from it and rotate any AWS or GitHub credentials exposed to the build environment.
